escena: SCENE (creative workshop, Santiago studio, the team lays out the first cut of a campaign): 8mm FISHEYE lens with strong, obvious barrel distortion, camera very low right at the near edge of a round dark walnut work table. Three people lean in over the table from the far side, placing printed storyboard frames and pointing at one of them; one woman laughing at the exact moment she slides the chosen frame to the centre. A single low practical softbox on a floor stand, riggeed between knee and chest height on the right, is the key light and rakes across the table and their hands. Plain clothes in charcoal, cream and olive; one plain azure-blue (#0375DB) notebook on the table carries the only blue. The ceiling curves but stays dark and plain. Nobody looks at the lens. Frames and notes carry only tiny, out-of-focus illegible marks, unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the curved near edge of the dark walnut table, so close to the lens that it dissolves into blur

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed plaster wall
